STUK for Samsung Galaxy S22

Open STUK-Rurik-Hagman.apk on the phone.
If Android asks, allow installation from the browser or file manager you used.
Tap Install, then Open.

The app includes the fixed Rurik Hagman profile and runs offline.
No computer, Android Studio, or extra asset installation is needed after downloading.

For a direct Wi-Fi download from the Mac, run:
  python3 Android/scripts/share_apk.py
Open the printed address on the phone while both devices use the same Wi-Fi.
